mechanism: Incorporating a thermally conductive, lattice-structured electrode tip to enhance heat dissipation and reduce power density at the target zone.
how_it_addresses_failure: By providing a larger surface area for heat dissipation, the lattice structure reduces the temperature at the active electrode, thereby minimizing thermal spread.
falsifier: If the lattice structure does not significantly reduce thermal spread or compromises cutting/coagulation efficacy.

mechanism: Implementing a real-time thermal spread monitoring system using machine learning algorithms to adjust RF energy delivery parameters and maintain optimal power density.
how_it_addresses_failure: By continuously monitoring thermal spread and adjusting RF energy delivery, the system can adapt to changing tissue properties and maintain precision while reducing collateral damage.
falsifier: If the system fails to accurately predict thermal spread or adjust RF energy delivery parameters effectively.

mechanism: Developing a temperature-sensitive, phase-change material (PCM) that can be integrated into the electrode tip to absorb excess heat and transition to a lower thermal conductivity state.
how_it_addresses_failure: By absorbing excess heat and transitioning to a lower thermal conductivity state, the PCM reduces thermal spread and maintains precision at the target zone.
falsifier: If the PCM does not effectively absorb excess heat or compromise cutting/coagulation efficacy.

mechanism: Designing a novel, hydrophobic electrode surface coating to reduce tissue adherence and minimize thermal spread by preventing the formation of a thermal gradient.
how_it_addresses_failure: By reducing tissue adherence and preventing the formation of a thermal gradient, the hydrophobic coating minimizes thermal spread and maintains precision at the target zone.
falsifier: If the coating does not effectively reduce tissue adherence or compromise cutting/coagulation efficacy.

mechanism: Incorporating a miniature, high-temperature superconducting coil near the active electrode to redirect excess RF energy away from the target zone and into a heat sink.
how_it_addresses_failure: By redirecting excess RF energy away from the target zone, the superconducting coil reduces thermal spread and maintains precision while minimizing collateral damage.
falsifier: If the superconducting coil does not effectively redirect excess RF energy or compromise cutting/coagulation efficacy.
